title: 6-Hour Fast Charger 67.2V 5A XTRON
body_html:
⚠️ Compatibility Notice: This charger is designed exclusively for the YUME XTRON. It is NOT compatible with any other YUME scooter models.

YUME XTRON 67.2V 5A Charger

The 67.2V 5A Charger provides reliable and efficient charging for the YUME XTRON.

Charging Time

  • 1 × 5A charger: Approximately 5–6 hours for a full charge
  • 1 × 5A charger + 1 × 2A charger: Approximately 4–5 hours for a full charge
  • 2 × 5A chargers: Approximately 3 hours for a full charge
  • 1 × 10A charger: Approximately 3 hours for a full charge

For faster charging, you can use either two 5A chargers simultaneously or a single 10A Fast Charger. One 10A charger provides the same total charging current as two 5A chargers while requiring only one charger.

Click here to purchase the XTRON 10A Fast Charger: https://www.yumescooter.com/products/3-hour-fast-charger-67-2v-10a-xtron

⚠️ Important Charging Limit

The XTRON supports a maximum total charging current of 10A. You may use:

  • 1 × 5A charger
  • 1 × 5A charger + 1 × 2A charger simultaneously
  • 2 × 5A chargers simultaneously
  • 1 × 10A charger

STRICTLY PROHIBITED:

  • DO NOT use a 10A charger and a 5A charger at the same time.
  • DO NOT use two 10A chargers at the same time.

Any combination exceeding the supported 10A total charging current may damage the battery or charging system.

Built-In Charging Protection

The charger includes built-in protection systems designed to help protect the charger and battery during normal use:

  • Overload protection
  • Over-voltage protection
  • Under-voltage protection
  • Short-circuit protection

Charging Status Indicator

The built-in LED indicator makes it easy to check the charging status:

  • Red Light: Charging
  • Green Light: Fully charged

Once the battery reaches full charge, the charger automatically stops charging.

Active Cooling System

An integrated cooling fan helps dissipate heat during charging and keeps the charger operating at a suitable temperature. This supports stable charging performance and helps extend the charger's service life.

Important Notes

  • Designed exclusively for the YUME XTRON 67.2V charging system.
  • Not compatible with other YUME scooter models.
  • The charger is not waterproof. Keep it dry during use and storage.
  • Always charge in a dry, well-ventilated area.
  • Do not cover the charger while it is operating.
  • Do not use the charger if the charger, cable, plug, or scooter charging port appears damaged.
  • Maximum supported charging current for the XTRON: 10A total.
  • Never combine a 10A charger with any other charger.

Recommended Charging Procedure

  1. Connect the charger to the XTRON charging port.
  2. Connect the charger to the AC power outlet.
  3. Allow the battery to charge until the indicator turns green.
  4. Disconnect the charger from the AC power outlet first.
  5. Then disconnect the charger from the scooter.

When using two chargers (2 × 5A, or 1 × 5A + 1 × 2A), connect one charger to each charging port. The combined charging current must not exceed 10A. Never use a 10A charger together with any other charger.

title: Worry-Free Delivery
body_html:
What it is

Worry-Free Delivery is an optional protection service that helps you resolve issues if your package is lost, stolen, or damaged in transit. For a small fee, we provide priority assistance and, where eligible, a replacement or refund.

What's covered

  • ✅ Loss in transit — Packages confirmed lost by the carrier before delivery.
  • ✅ Theft after delivery — Packages marked delivered but not received, with supporting evidence.
  • ✅ Damage — Items that arrive damaged, reported with photo or video evidence.

How to file a claim

To process your claim, we need your cooperation with the following. Claims cannot be processed without them:

  • Report the issue within 7 calendar days of the delivery date (or the estimated delivery date for lost items).
  • Provide your order number, plus photos or video of the damaged item and its packaging (for damage claims).
  • Provide a signed statement of non-receipt, and for theft, a police report or filing reference where required.
  • Reasonably cooperate with the carrier's investigation if one is opened.

Processing time

We aim to review eligible claims within 1–2 business days and resolve them within 7 business days after all required information is received.

Not covered

  • Claims filed after the 7-day reporting window.
  • Incorrect or incomplete shipping addresses provided by the customer.
  • Packages confirmed delivered where the evidence does not support loss or theft.
  • Claims where the customer declines to provide the required documentation.
  • Minor cosmetic damage that does not affect function.

Worry-Free Delivery provides claim assistance and supplements carrier liability; it is not an insurance policy. Coverage is subject to the terms above.

title: Charger 67.2V 2A Raptor2
body_html:
The Smart Li-ion Battery Charger was specifically designed to enhance YUME electric scooters' charging capacity and their overall durability. The power adapter is especially suitable for YUME electric vehicles and battery packs but yes, it's also suitable for other brands' bikes, scooters, unicycles, battery packs, etc. It is compatible with about 99% of the lithium battery products on the market.

The Smart Li-ion battery charger's built-in safety functions include overload protection, upper and lower limit protection of working voltage, and short circuit protection. The power pack shell is made of high-quality plastic to provide the internal connections with the uttermost protection.

The Yume Li-ion battery charger has a power indicator that lets you know your battery's charging level at the time. It displays a red light when charging and a green light when fully charged. Also, the power pack automatically stops charging once the battery is fully charged.

The charger has an in-built fan that readily disperses any pile of dust that gets absorbed into it. Also, this in-built fan works with the charger's inner radiating fin to dissipate heat through the power pack shell. With this mechanism in place, your charger won't feel like a sauna when charging your battery. And due to this heat and dust dissipating system, your charger will definitely last much longer.

Note:
This Li-ion battery charger is not waterproof so it needs to be kept dry during use. If it gets wet accidentally, it is recommended that you air-dry it before using it.

Operational Instructions:
When about to begin charging, first connect the charger to the battery/vehicle before connecting the charger to the AC. And once your battery is fully charged, turn off the AC before pulling the battery plug; after that, you can now disconnect the charger from your battery. If you pull the battery plug first while the battery is still charging, especially when the charging current is still high, your battery and charger can easily get damaged.

title: Charger 67.2V 2A Raptor
body_html:
The Smart Li-ion Battery Charger was specifically designed to enhance YUME electric scooters' charging capacity and their overall durability. The power adapter is especially suitable for YUME electric vehicles and battery packs but yes, it's also suitable for other brands' bikes, scooters, unicycles, battery packs, etc. It is compatible with about 99% of the lithium battery products on the market.

The Smart Li-ion battery charger's built-in safety functions include overload protection, upper and lower limit protection of working voltage, and short circuit protection. The power pack shell is made of high-quality plastic to provide the internal connections with the uttermost protection.

The Yume Li-ion battery charger has a power indicator that lets you know your battery's charging level at the time. It displays a red light when charging and a green light when fully charged. Also, the power pack automatically stops charging once the battery is fully charged.

The charger has an in-built fan that readily disperses any pile of dust that gets absorbed into it. Also, this in-built fan works with the charger's inner radiating fin to dissipate heat through the power pack shell. With this mechanism in place, your charger won't feel like a sauna when charging your battery. And due to this heat and dust dissipating system, your charger will definitely last much longer.

Note:
This Li-ion battery charger is not waterproof so it needs to be kept dry during use. If it gets wet accidentally, it is recommended that you air-dry it before using it.

Operational Instructions:
When about to begin charging, first connect the charger to the battery/vehicle before connecting the charger to the AC. And once your battery is fully charged, turn off the AC before pulling the battery plug; after that, you can now disconnect the charger from your battery. If you pull the battery plug first while the battery is still charging, especially when the charging current is still high, your battery and charger can easily get damaged.

title: Charger 84V 5A   Osprey
body_html:
The Smart Li-ion Battery Charger was specifically designed to enhance YUME electric scooters' charging capacity and their overall durability. The power adapter is especially suitable for YUME electric vehicles and battery packs but yes, it's also suitable for other brands' bikes, scooters, unicycles, battery packs, etc. It is compatible with about 99% of the lithium battery products on the market.

The Smart Li-ion battery charger's built-in safety functions include overload protection, upper and lower limit protection of working voltage, and short circuit protection. The power pack shell is made of high-quality plastic to provide the internal connections with the uttermost protection.

The Yume Li-ion battery charger has a power indicator that lets you know your battery's charging level at the time. It displays a red light when charging and a green light when fully charged. Also, the power pack automatically stops charging once the battery is fully charged.

The charger has an in-built fan that readily disperses any pile of dust that gets absorbed into it. Also, this in-built fan works with the charger's inner radiating fin to dissipate heat through the power pack shell. With this mechanism in place, your charger won't feel like a sauna when charging your battery. And due to this heat and dust dissipating system, your charger will definitely last much longer.

Note:
This Li-ion battery charger is not waterproof so it needs to be kept dry during use. If it gets wet accidentally, it is recommended that you air-dry it before using it.

Operational Instructions:
When about to begin charging, first connect the charger to the battery/vehicle before connecting the charger to the AC. And once your battery is fully charged, turn off the AC before pulling the battery plug; after that, you can now disconnect the charger from your battery. If you pull the battery plug first while the battery is still charging, especially when the charging current is still high, your battery and charger can easily get damaged.
